title: Misfit Music Project — Artist Manifest
description: Canonical schema for an artist manifest in the Misfit Music Discovery index. Artists own their manifests; this schema keeps the index consistent and machine-validatable.

manifest_version.description: Semver of the manifest schema. Bump when the schema changes.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this manifest was last generated/updated.

location.description: Human-readable location, e.g. 'Tokyo, Japan' or 'Portland, Oregon'.

genres.description: Genre tags used for search and filtering.

bio.description: Short artist description. Plain text; HTML is not rendered.

contact.description: Optional contact email. Omit or null if none.

preview.description: Optional path to a short audio clip, e.g. 'previews/<name>.wav'. Null/empty if not available; the site shows 'preview pending'.

releases.description: Optional list of releases. Omit entirely when empty.
